plain_deep_curve.description: Known completed representation; new variants finish a representative.

conv3.description: Known completed representation; new variants finish a representative.

conv7.description: Known completed representation; new variants finish a representative.

calibration.margin_rule: twice largest observed post-halfway deficit that a later-winning reference recovered
calibration.patience_rule: largest observed interval between material validation improvements
calibration.cooldown_rule: largest observed delay from a half-rate crossing to material validation improvement
calibration.stall_rule: largest per-run90th percentile of late-quarter relative validation changes

limitations: Small completed-history sample. Only known model variants on exactly matched data/optimizer/LR/runtime are eligible; unfamiliar variants/schedules/splits finish a representative.

exclusions.reason: Augmented fitting inputs/targets change convergence regime; excluded from the unaugmented comparison cohort.

exclusions.run: Other splits/data sizes/optimizers/schedules or unfamiliar architectures
exclusions.reason: Require compatible completed representatives before pruning.

draft_revision: An initial raw-spike/max-duration-times2 draft was rejected before deployment: it offered no eligible stopping window under this cosine schedule. Final margin uses the same prefix-best statistic as the decision; patience and cooldown cover observed maximum recovery intervals.
